title: Il castello dei quarantanove destini
author: Constrained text (QOuLiPo project)
style: Calvino (Il castello dei destini incrociati, Le citta invisibili); tarot-driven micro-narrative
description: 49-page Italian constrained text arranged on a 7x7 grid. Each page is one 'destino' (fate) told in a tarot-like idiom. King-adjacent and extended-king-adjacent pages (Chebyshev distance <= 2) share characters, objects, and thematic tokens. Non-adjacent pages are independent. The graph is an exact 2D UDG on 49 atoms by construction: atom positions ARE the grid coordinates, and the blockade radius R_b = 2*sqrt(2)*a realises the Chebyshev-<=2 adjacency exactly.
paper: Jurczak 2026, arXiv (QOuLiPo: What a quantum computer sees when it reads a book)
accent_restoration_note: Accent restoration: first-pass automated via curated word-level dictionary (corpus/_restore_accents.py); covers ~50 common forms. Native Italian review recommended; ambiguous monosyllables (si/sì, e/è, ne/né) intentionally left unaccented to avoid over-substitution.
